LRF PHOTO STUDIO — SlimSAM local mask refinement

Model: Xenova/slimsam-77-uniform
Publisher: Xenova / Hugging Face
Model card: https://huggingface.co/Xenova/slimsam-77-uniform
Pinned revision: 5850ab45f587c112167512ffef949107115e26a0
Upstream model: nielsr/slimsam-77-uniform
Research: SlimSAM: 0.1% Data Makes Segment Anything Slim
Authors: Zigeng Chen, Gongfan Fang, Xinyin Ma, Xinchao Wang
Project: https://github.com/czg1225/SlimSAM

License: Apache License 2.0, as declared by the model publisher and the
upstream project. The license copy is SLIMSAM-APACHE-2.0.txt, sourced at
upstream commit 2ddb8f7a8400344b4e64ed32f0197af9007a9aa0.

The model config, processor config and both quantized ONNX files are
unmodified publisher bytes. Exact source URLs, sizes and SHA-256 digests
are recorded in ../../manifest.json. The two ONNX files total 13,785,975
bytes; the model's five downloaded files total 13,798,177 bytes.

Local pretrained identifier: slimsam-77-5850ab4-q8-v1
Directory relative to the vendor root: models/slimsam-77-5850ab4-q8-v1/
Runtime: @huggingface/transformers 3.8.1, dtype q8, WASM.
Vision encoder: onnx/vision_encoder_quantized.onnx
Prompt and mask decoder: onnx/prompt_encoder_mask_decoder_quantized.onnx

The encoder runs locally on a photo once. Its cached embeddings support
subsequent positive/negative point prompts in the small mask decoder.
SAM refines a region selected by prompts; it does not classify a surface
as a floor by itself and does not establish the floor's perspective.

WebSAM (https://github.com/Xevion/WebSAM) was examined as an architecture
reference. No code from that unlicensed repository is included here.
Implementation follows the published model interfaces independently.
